risk._micro_note: MICRO-LIVE sizing for a ~$130 bankroll across 3 coins. Worst-case committed exposure 3 x 2 x $15 = $90; worst-case settled day 3 x -$25 = -$75. The halt ladder is identical to paper -- it detects breakage in ~20 markets, which at micro size costs cents, exactly when detection is cheapest. Scale sizes only AFTER a week of live-vs-paper reconciliation, and A/B the raise in paper first.

rollavg_edge._size_note: 10 shares (~$9 at typical fill px) against paper's 100. Every GATE is identical to the frozen paper config -- same zmin, same max_price, same window -- so live and paper disagree only about execution, which is the one thing micro-live exists to measure. The venue min is 5 shares; risk room below that is logged as live_miss/below_venue_min, not sent.
